corrections: File creation in web container is not an HTTP upload or proof of PHP execution; web FIM and DVWA storage are separate.
JNDI string and 403 establish a request/response observation, not Java execution. WAF cause needs a separate matching record.
Shellshock 31168/31169 depend on 31108 (simple 2xx/3xx requests); names/200 do not prove Bash execution.
DVWA Low handler requires POST Submit. A GET URL and a submitted POST form are not equivalent; POST values may be absent from access URL.
31106 identifies suspicious URL plus 200, not independently confirmed exploitation.
31152/31153/31154 are repeated SQLi/common web attack/XSS rules. 501/500/503 repeat rules are 31161/31162/31163.
Slide 275 shows SQLi rule31103 plus status500, not confirmed repeated500. Calculation table explicitly illustrative, not measured.
